subject: Startups
title: Data Privacy Laws
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Data Privacy Laws.

buildup.text: GDPR, CCPA, and similar laws require explicit consent, data minimization, and the right to be forgotten.

discovery.text: Privacy-by-design means building compliance into the product from day one, not bolting it on after a regulator knocks.

twist.text: Strict privacy laws birthed a new category: privacy-tech.

climax.text: Start with minimal data collection. You can't leak data you never collected.

punchline.text: Collect less. Encrypt more. Sleep better.

quiz.question: What is 'privacy-by-design'?
options: Building compliance into the product architecture from day one
